sources.title: [PATCH v4 2/2] media: i2c: imx678: Add driver for Sony IMX678

claims.claim: Add a V4L2 subdev driver for the Sony IMX678 image sensor. IMX678 is a diagonal 8.86 mm (Type 1/1.8) CMOS active pixel type solid-state image sensor with a square pixel array and 8.40 M effective pixels. claims.claim: Sony IMX678 is an 8.4 Megapixel (3856x2180) CMOS sensor, that can output pixels over MIPI CSI-2 bus. Add bindings for it. Runtime detection for mono vs color variant of this sensor is feasible by reading a register, but it's not always desirable given the sensor needs to be powered on for it, potentially flashing a privacy LED or wasting precious boot time.
